notes.title: Game Update: Demo Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444131/f77cee1f89ed9e0a405b3a9e7585720122113b60.png

Hello everyone!

First of all, I want to express my deepest gratitude for your interest in my game. Your support provides tremendous motivation to continue with the development.

I'm excited to announce that very soon, I'll be releasing a playable demo! This will give you the opportunity to try the game and share your opinions while I work on completing the full version. The game is actually quite far along in development, and I've spent these last few months polishing the demo to ensure it represents the quality I aim to achieve in the final product.

Since I'm still working on the game, your feedback will be invaluable in helping me implement improvements I might have overlooked. I encourage you to suggest enhancements for the game, always with respect, of course.

In future updates, I'll be sharing more about the game's overall story and characters, so stay tuned for that!

I hope that with your comments and suggestions, we can create a game we can all be proud of.

Thank you very much!
